english:
Hey!
I remember your face!\pIf you're here, it must mean that
you're about to mess with us again!\pA punk like you, do you really think
you can take on TEAM AQUA?\pI'd say you're too early by about
a trillion years!\pYou're a perfect fit for the likes of
TEAM MAGMA!\pSpeaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they
were spotted near MOSSDEEP.\pThat bunch of goons, they sure don't
look good near the sea!
dutch:
Hé!
Ik ken jouw gezicht!\pAls je hier bent, ga je ons weer
dwarszitten!\pDenk je echt dat een straatschender
als jij TEAM AQUA aankan?\pJe bent zo'n biljoen jaar
te vroeg!\pJij past veel beter bij
TEAM MAGMA!\pTEAM MAGMA is trouwens gezien
bij MOSSDEEP.\pDie bende boeven past niet bij
de zee!
